assertions: Generator v21 validates eleven explicit diagnostic_minimum_bytes opt-ins across five definitions. Absent metadata differs from explicit zero; only min=1 identity/TBCD and UTF8/octet primitives with exact existing Nonempty minima are accepted.

Quotes validate key/path/flags/type/width and depth/count/field/frame/reply limits before allocation. Zero/one-byte payloads have exact unpadded AVP Length and zero padding. Explicit proof failure never falls back to legacy untyped placeholders.

Twenty-four TCP/TLS ordinary/emergency leaf cases cover combined ServiceContext and second SubscriptionID, S6c SCAddress/DestinationRealm and SGd OFR SCAddress/SMRPUI. Return envelope, held charges, invalid non-delivery, subsequent valid work and retirement are checked.

Base CER/CEA ProductName, S6c UserIdentifier.MSISDN, SGd TFR SMRPUI and DCCA SubscriptionIDData have selected codec tests. Empty presence remains distinct from omission; contextual domain constraints remain intact. Base coverage does not add handshake reply policy.

Unselected TFR SCAddress remains unsupported despite the OFR same-key opt-in. Bare/invalid proofs and unreviewed groups stay closed; variable opt-ins do not widen whole-group minimum trees or conditional/cardinality rules.

Existing wire fields/rules/slice versions, public signatures/layouts and ops9 unchanged. All eleven generated digests and Bundle fingerprints change. README and historical benchmark remain byte-identical.
Fourteen finite fuzz targets and full dual-module static/pure/race/cross, pressure and separately sampled benchmarks. Pure Go/no persistence, module pins and immutable tags unchanged.
